value: Limited Data Sets (LDS) will be available in the future via a secure cloud environment for a fee. Biospecimens are not available for request at this time. The following requirements must be met before CADRE data will be shared: The Third-Party Investigator must briefly present the research concept to the Steering Committee. The Publications and Steering Committees must approve the investigator's analysis proposal. The Third-Party Site must sign an FDP Data Transfer and Use Agreement (DTUA) with UW-Madison.

The Children’s Allergy and Asthma Data Repository (CADRE) is a centralized resource created to address a critical gap in asthma research: identifying the risk factors and biological mechanisms that lead to childhood asthma. By uniting data from various cohorts, CADRE empowers researchers to uncover insights that individual studies alone cannot provide.
